note: Dynasty collection goals: long-term targets about what you own and how far you have mastered it. Each is checked against the loaded content release by filters, never by card id, so a new release needs no change here. Types: owned (own `need` different cards matching `filter`: rarity, position, team, edition, min_overall), mastery_total (the sum of every card's mastery levels reaches `need`), mastery_card (one card reaches mastery level `need`), teams (own cards from `need` different teams). A goal is claimed once; the reward goes through the economy. Edit numbers here, not code.

goals.name: Every position covered
goals.text: Own a point guard, shooting guard, small forward, power forward and center.

goals.name: First polish
goals.text: Raise any card to mastery level 1.

goals.name: Dedicated
goals.text: Raise any card to mastery level 3.

goals.name: Master collector
goals.text: Reach 10 mastery levels across all your cards.
